source: Kansas Lottery official Scratch prize inventory

catalogs.coverage: Scratch games with no announced end or claim deadline in listing metadata; excludes Pull Tabs and historical/closing listings. Remaining prize inventory only, including categorical free-ticket tiers; no dated claims or retailer joins.
catalogs.updateCadence: Source states hourly remaining-prize updates; checked every six hours.
